next_step: Document handoff to partner infra team; follow-up paused due to vendor selection finalization
notes:
Background: SummitNode is a managed edge-hosting platform focused on real-time customer support and content personalization. Evaluated Redwood for hosted API (fastest time-to-value) and Redwood Private for VPC deployment. After PoC, engineering opted to build a self-hosted stack using vLLM + Triton/TensorRT and TGI to reduce per-token cost and keep full control over KV cache and privacy.

Sales/AE notes: - Initial inbound (trade show) 2025-09-18, demo 2025-10-02. - Security review kicked off 2025-10-20; primary ask: audit logging + strict residency controls. - PoC (latency/throughput) run 2025-11-10 to 2025-11-22 with Redwood hosted model (curated). Results: Redwood met latency targets but cost extrapolation higher than in-house infra for high-volume tails. - Quote provided 2025-11-25; procurement cost-sensitivity call 2025-11-28.

Customer quotes / paraphrases: - "We need absolute control over the KV/cache and GPU scheduling — can't accept black-box routing right now." - "If we can bring cost down 40% by self-hosting and avoid egress risk, execs will greenlight it."

POC/Tech details: - Workload: conversational agent + embeddings store for 100M documents; peak QPS ~150 p50 latency target 120ms. - Redwood handled correctness and latency but cost model didn't meet summitnode's projections for sustained 24/7 inference at scale. - Security team ran a red-team style checklist; gap items included retention controls granularity and vendor-side KMS policies (they required on-prem HSM).

Decision: Closed-lost to self-host. Engineering chose vLLM + TGI + TensorRT-LLM stack; internal infra team to own rollout. Primary drivers: ongoing unit cost, control over scheduling/kv cache, and preference for air-gapped/hsm options.

Follow-ups/Notes for future re-engagement: - Leave a lightweight architecture brief tailored to their cost model (show hybrid routing opportunity). - Offer a short workshop on migration patterns (how to integrate Redwood Private later if they want managed control). - Reconnect after Q2 2026 (budget cycle) or if self-host ops cost or quality regressions appear.

Staging comment: account stalled after 2025-12-05; multiple contacts unresponsive as vendor selection completed.
